name: Trip Cancellation Refund Receipt
description: Confirmation sent when a participant cancels a trip registration and a refund is raised
subject: Cancellation confirmed for {trip_name} - £{refund_amount} refunded
body_html:
Trip Cancellation Confirmed

Dear {participant_name},

Your registration for {trip_name} has been cancelled and your place released. A refund has been raised.

Cancelled registration

Trip{trip_name}
Destination{destination}
Dates{trip_dates}
Registration{registration_reference}

Refund

Amount£{refund_amount}
Method{payment_method}
Reference{refund_reference}
Date{refund_date}

{settlement_line}

If you did not request this cancellation, contact the trips office immediately.

{signature}

participant_name.description: Name of the person who cancelled

trip_dates.description: Trip dates, already formatted (a single date for single-day trips)

registration_reference.description: Registration/participant reference for the cancelled booking

refund_amount.description: Refund amount, formatted to two decimal places without the currency symbol

payment_method.description: Method the trip was originally paid by

settlement_line.description: How the money comes back — credited to the finance account, or settled to the original method

separator.description: Visual separator for the text version

signature.description: Email signature; supplied by the renderer when omitted
